name: Yogurt (Lactose-Free)
siboNotes: Lactose-free yogurt is safe for SIBO. Check ingredients for high-FODMAP additives like inulin, chicory root fiber, honey, agave, or high-FODMAP fruits. Plain is safest, add your own toppings.
preparationTips: Choose plain and add safe toppings
Avoid versions with honey or agave
Add safe fruits and maple syrup
